interpretation.sourceStringsPolicy: Preserve every spelling exactly as printed in Tables 4–8. Use the candidate names only in a separately attributed nomenclatural crosswalk; do not rewrite counts, merge source rows, or imply specimen determination.
limits: No voucher identifiers, specimen catalog numbers, diagnostic descriptions, or author-confirmed mapping from each table spelling to a physical fish were retrieved.
